title: Make the Right Piece
setup: Black's rook attacks the f-pawn from g7, the king attacks it too, and one defender cannot hold it against two, so White has exactly one move to use it.
hint: The pawn is lost next move whatever you do. Ask which new piece would touch the rook on g7.
explanation:
## The Idea

The pawn cannot be held, so spend it. {{f8=Q}} attacks the rook beside it and wins. {{f8=R}} and {{f8=N+}} leave g7 alone, and {{f8=B}} hits the rook but is not enough to win. Black must save the rook with {{Rxa7}}, and queen against rook is winning.
